units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 7:2">Men. VII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 77b:2">77ᵇ</cite>) (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 7:14">Lev. VII, 14</cite>) <he>שלא יטול פ׳</he> this indicates that he shall not take a piece of a cake; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 3:1">Shek. III, 1</cite> <he>בפרוס הפסח וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>בפְרַס</he>) at half the period of preparation for the Passover &c. (during which the laws of the respective festival are expounded); v. Y. ib. III, beg. 47ᵇ <he>פלגא בשלשים יום</he> half of the thirty days.
